intended_object: The natural bijection between maps π₀(J) → X and functors J ⥤ Discrete X. It is the hom-set bijection of the adjunction π₀ ⊣ (discrete category functor). Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: This is the standard bijection showing that π₀ is left adjoint to the discrete-category functor (it feeds `CategoryTheory.Cat.connectedComponents` ⊣ `typeToCat`). The forward direction sends f to the functor j ↦ f[j], which is well defined because each morphism lies in a zigzag. The inverse lifts F.obj through the zigzag quotient; this works because a functor into a discrete category is constant on zigzag classes. Both round trips are proved. The setting is already fully general: an arbitrary category J and an arbitrary type X, with any universes. The definition is the hom-equivalence itself, not a special case of some broader Mathlib construction.
